ref_text: THE LAW OF THAT SCHOOL IS THAT EVERYTHING SHALL BE SEEN CLEARLY OR AT LEAST ONLY IN SUCH MIST OR FAINTNESS AS SHALL BE DELIGHTFUL AND I HAVE NO DOUBT THAT THE BEST INTRODUCTION TO IT WOULD BE THE ELEMENTARY PRACTICE OF PAINTING EVERY STUDY ON A GOLDEN GROUND
text: The law of that school is that everything shall be seen clearly, or at least only in such misdorfaintness as shall be delightful. And I have no doubt that the best introduction to it would be the elementary practice of painting every study on a golden ground.
